remarks: Confirm pet policy with agent. This beautifully renovated 4-bedroom rental, located in the peaceful Pemberwick neighborhood of Greenwich, combines modern comfort with everyday convenience. Spanning the second and third floors, the home offers generous space for family or guests. The brand-new kitchen is a standout with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, while adjustable recessed lighting throughout the home allows you to set the perfect mood. Each room is pre-wired for wall-mounted TVs, and the hardwood floors bring warmth and character to every space. Enjoy year-round comfort with a modern HVAC system. Additional features include an in-unit washer & dryer and a 2-car driveway. Lawn care and snow removal included!
